text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(I will shine brighter than anyone.
I will make sure I'm the one left standing!)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: (So, look at Machan.)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: (Look only at Chan-me...!)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaaahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
W-Wah...! It's Chan, it's Aston Machan!
The winner is Machan!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Aston Machan!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
M-My breath caught in my throat...!
Even if I wanted to look away, I just couldn't!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: The moment she crossed the finish line, I... I ended up crying. Chan is just incredible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...Last year was amazing.
I still remember it."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was looking at Machan,
smiling and giving a thunderous round of applause.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Still, right now—right now, it's even more incredible.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In everyone's eyes...
...a sparkling Chan-Mee is reflected.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It's showing right there.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: "Thank you for an unforgettable race, Chan-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"I'm looking forward
to your next race too!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...It's Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's Aston Machan.
You remembered, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. Thank goodness.
